messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: program using the method mlr
parts:
Not sure what you are attempting, but it looks like you are trying to use both (D)WLS and ML(R) estimation.  You don't have to set the se= or test= arguments when you set estimator="MLR" because the latter implies estimator="ML" with the se= and test= options you set (although test="Yuan.Bentler.Mplus" is another "MLR" option ).  This all requires raw data, not summary statistics, and the WLS.V= and NACOV= arguments are for categorical data (with DWLS estimation).  

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
